newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish foresters fear weakening pulpwood demand.
newsitem.headline: Finnish foresters fear weakening pulpwood demand.

text.p: The Finnish forest industry's demand for pulpwood may be weaker next year than in 1997, a senior official of the Central Union of Agricultural Producers and Forest Owners (MTK) said in a statement on Tuesday.

"The export market outlook for forest industry products is still unclear concerning the price trend for chemical forest industry products, while markets for sawn goods have improved substantially," MTK forest delegation chairman Ahti Huovinen said in the text of a prepared speech.
"Due to the market situation it is easy to forecast that demand will continue to focus strongly on logwood and it can be feared that demand for pulpwood will be even weaker than this year," he said.
Overall, the Finnish forest industry's demand for raw wood would be clearly higher in 1997 than this year, he added.
